reset.subject: Argus password reset
reset.heading: New password
paragraphs: To set a new password, press the button. The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once.
reset.note: Did not ask for this? Just ignore this email, your password stays the same.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Argus
welcome.heading: Account created
paragraphs: You signed up for Argus with {email}.
Open the app and start recognition. The balance is spent on recognition, answers and voice; you can top it up in the settings.
welcome.gift: A welcome gift of {amount} has been added to your balance.
welcome.note: Did not sign up? Write to us and we will delete the account.

password_changed.subject: Argus password changed
password_changed.heading: Password changed
paragraphs: The password for {email} was changed on {when}.
You were signed out of every app. Sign in again with the new password.
password_changed.note: Was this not you? Write to us and we will help you get access back.

top_up.subject: Argus balance topped up
top_up.heading: Thank you for your top-up
paragraphs: The payment was received and the money is on your balance.
top_up.note: Did not make this payment? Write to us.

low.subject: Your Argus balance is running low
low.heading: Balance is running low
paragraphs: To keep recognition going, top up your balance in the app settings.

empty.subject: Your Argus balance is empty
empty.heading: Balance is empty
paragraphs: Recognition, answers and voice are paused while the balance is empty.
You can top it up in the app settings.

deleted.subject: Argus account deleted
deleted.heading: Account deleted
paragraphs: The account {email} has been deleted: the address, password and sign-ins are erased.
The remaining balance went with the account. Payment records are kept with no link to you.
deleted.note: Did you not do this? Write to us.

footer: This message was sent automatically. Questions: {support}.

reset_page.title: New password — Argus
reset_page.heading: New password
reset_page.bad_link: The link does not work — request a new one in the app.
reset_page.saved: Password saved. Go back to the app and sign in again.
reset_page.short: The password must be at least {min} characters.
reset_page.weak: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
reset_page.busy: The server is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
reset_page.limit: Too many attempts. Try again later.
